definition: The kind of period: point_in_time, span, cohort, fiscal_year, or calendar_year.
The date on which this became effective.
The date on which this ceased to be effective.
The granularity of the period: year, quarter, month, week, day, or hour.
An SDMX REF_PERIOD type identifier when relevant (for example, the reference week for labour force surveys, the academic year for school-attendance metrics).

The SDMX FREQ code for this period: A (annual), Q (quarterly), M (monthly), W (weekly), D (daily), H (hourly). Carried as a single-letter code; resolves to urn:sdmx:org.sdmx.infomodel.codelist.Codelist=SDMX:CL_FREQ. Named observation_frequency to avoid collision with the benefit-delivery frequency slot in schema/program.yaml.
